title: Crossover — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for Crossover.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Commercial Crossover." Specialty tier. Crossover is Alliance Laundry Systems crossover brand — commercial-grade machines designed for residential installation. Bridges the gap between residential Speed Queen and commercial Huebsch.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Customers who want true commercial-grade at home. Multi-unit residential properties.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for Crossover:

• True commercial-grade for residential installation

• Alliance Laundry Systems engineering

• Bridge between Speed Queen and Huebsch

• Commercial durability with residential hookups

• Ideal for multi-unit properties
